g.text: Five stores speak the S3 API and share its tools: aws s3 sync uploads and copies, goofys mounts (rclone on ARM), and rclone serves MOUNT_CACHED with a disk cache per mount.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: The other five bring their own: gsutil and gcsfuse, az, blobfuse2 and azcopy, rclone for IBM COS, the oci CLI with rclone, and huggingface_hub with hf-mount; IBM COS has no MOUNT_CACHED.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Uploads run where the API server runs; every mount and every copy runs on each node of the cluster.
